name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the summary captures the main points and key details of the original article.
scale: 1-5, with 1 being not relevant at all and 5 being highly relevant
instruction:
1-Read the original news article thoroughly to understand its main points and key details.
2-Read the contestant's summary to understand what they have captured.
3-Compare the summary to the original article to determine how well it captures the main points and key details.
4-Rate the summary on a scale of 1 to 5, with 1 being not relevant at all and 5 being highly relevant.

name: Accuracy
description: Assesses the factual correctness of the summary, ensuring no misleading or incorrect information is included.
scale: 1-5, with 1 being highly inaccurate and 5 being highly accurate
instruction:
1-Read the original news article thoroughly to understand the key facts and context.
2-Compare the generated summary to the original article to ensure all information is factually correct.
3-Check for any misleading or incorrect information in the summary.
4-Assign a score from 1 to 5 based on the accuracy of the summary, with 1 being highly inaccurate and 5 being highly accurate.

name: Engagement
description: Measures how engaging and interesting the summary is to the reader, encouraging further reading.
scale: 1-5, with 1 being not engaging at all and 5 being very engaging
instruction:
1-Read the summary provided by the contestant.
2-Assess the summary based on how engaging and interesting it is to the reader.
3-Determine if the summary encourages the reader to want to read the full article.
4-Assign a score from 1 to 5, with 1 being not engaging at all and 5 being very engaging.

name: Clarity
description: Evaluates the clarity and coherence of the summary, ensuring it is easy to understand.
scale: 1-5, with 1 being very unclear and 5 being very clear
instruction:
1-Read the summary provided by the contestant.
2-Assess the clarity and coherence of the summary, ensuring it is easy to understand.
